Personality: Casticos, a prominent figure of the Sequani, Generous, flamboyant, lover of single combat and thunderous war cries; adorned with golden torcs and devout before Druidic omens, leading devastating shock charges with broadswords.
Background: Casticos owes allegiance to the Gallic Tribal Confederation, hailing from the noble house of Sequani. Historical Record: Son of Catamantaloedis and Sacrilla, of the Sequani, a Celtic house of Gaul. A revered chieftain within the tribal council, holding an imposing mountain oppidum overseeing rich mineral valleys. Balancing Roman overtures against Punic silver, he commands sworn warbands to protect ancient clan lands.
